results.title: Callback
results.overview: Max arrives home to find that his boyfriend has booked a callback. All hell breaks loose.

results.title: A Miss
results.overview: A former beauty pageant winner dreams that her daughter will follow the family tradition and win a Miss contest. However, she has neither the aptitude nor the interest for it. On the other hand, her son seems to have more talent to claim the sash and crown.

results.title: Jordi Fernádez's Coaching Journey: From Badalona to Brooklyn
results.original_title: Jordi Fernádez's Coaching Journey: From Badalona to Brooklyn
results.overview: Jordi Fernádez has always had the game of basketball in his blood. Born in the "Cradle of Basketball", Fernádez knew quickly he was meant to coach the game he loved. This is the story of his journey, which led him across the globe in his pursuit of coaching at the highest level.

results.title: Crossing A Dawn
results.overview: During a date, Xu Qiu and Chen Yuzhou's serendipitous encounter leads to repeatedly thwarted attempts at intimacy, yet a night of urban wonders gradually unveils their guarded emotions, culminating in an unforgettable love.

results.title: Gioia
results.overview: Gioia is a high school teacher who has never known any other love than the oppressive bond with her own parents, with whom she still lives. One of the students at her school, Alessio, is cashing in on his own body to make a couple of hundred euros to help his mother, a cashier in a supermarket. The relationship that dawns between Gioia and Alessio is forbidden fruit, fragile yet, inexplicably, one they can’t do without. Still, Alessio’s desire to improve his social standing is a silent killer that prevents him from ultimately accepting Gioia’s surprising affection for him. He goes and destroys it all, cancelling the only person who has ever loved him.

results.title: El fantasma de mi mujer
results.overview: Fernando's perfect life with wife María and mistress Julia shatters when Julia claims she accidentally killed María. After reporting María missing, Fernando receives a call from her - and his nightmare begins.

results.title: The Curse of Kampong Batu
results.original_title: បណ្ដាសាថ្មបិសាច
results.overview: Riya, a talented young dancer, was chosen to lead the total lunar eclipse ritual to maintain the balance between the human world and the spirit world. This aroused the jealousy of the other dancers, Noni and her sister Sara, who went so far as to scatter the frangipani flowers during the ritual. This is where the disaster began, with the rise of a demon that possessed Sara’s body.

results.title: Ekeko: el muñeco de la suerte
results.original_title: Ekeko: el muñeco de la suerte
results.overview: The story follows Gabriela, a young woman seeking to heal the deep wounds of a traumatic past. In her desperation, she decides to invoke a traditional Ekeko doll to heal and change her destiny. However, what initially seems to bring her good fortune soon transforms into her worst nightmare. The plot explores how the unbridled pursuit of prosperity distorts the amulet's essence when it interacts with Taitaorco, a powerful mountain spirit. Under the stark premise that "greed is a deadly sin" and "every stroke of luck comes at a price," a sinister ancestral rule is revealed: if the cigarette offered to the statuette goes out before burning completely, a portal to the underworld (Uku Pacha) opens, awakening malevolent entities ready to violently collect on favors rendered in exchange for your very soul.

results.title: N121 Bus de nuit
results.overview: Oscar, Simon, and Aïssa, three childhood friends, go to Paris to celebrate some good news. But on the night bus taking them home—the N121—an exchange between passengers spirals out of control, and the situation quickly goes off the rails.

results.title: Dangerous Citizen: The Life and Times of Abraham Polonsky
results.original_title: Dangerous Citizen: The Life and Times of Abraham Polonsky
results.overview: A portrait of blacklisted writer-director Abraham Polonsky.

results.title: Tame
results.original_title: เลี้ยงไม่เชื่อง
results.overview: In a remote village where bulls are trained through fear and tradition, a young girl held captive by her family seeks the power of an ancient spirit for liberation, employing the same cruel techniques used to control her.

results.title: MORELIFE
results.overview: A young man's plan to jump into an icy river at night is interrupted by a half-man half-fish there for the same reason. These two strike a bargain to find a rare Morel mushroom hoping it will provide something worth living for.

results.title: Escape at Alcatraz
results.overview: When a covert black-ops contractor seizes Alcatraz, the CIA smuggles hardened agent Lt. Jack Callahan inside to extract whistleblower Anya Turner and her damning evidence before the mission spirals into a deadly fight for survival.

results.title: Flying Tigers
results.overview: An Alzheimer-plagued mother’s fear of tigers in Assam sparks a multi-location probe into the US army unit supplying Kunming in WWII. A collective quest through history’s butterfly effects, told via found stories and turned hybrid.

results.title: National Theatre at Home: London Road
results.original_title: National Theatre at Home: London Road
results.overview: Autumn, 2006. The everyday life of the Suffolk town of Ipswich is shattered by the discovery of the bodies of five women. The occupant of No. 79 London Road is arrested, charged and finally convicted of the murders. Caught in the headlines and the invasion of their quiet road, the community grapples with what it means to be at the epicentre of the tragedy. Using their own words set to an innovative musical score, London Road is a moving story of ordinary people coming together during an extraordinary time. Director Rufus Norris, writer Alecky Blythe, and composer Adam Cork reunite for this highly anticipated return of the remarkable, award-winning verbatim musical.

results.title: Only the Whites of Our Eyes
results.overview: An elderly man must stay with his estranged son for a few days because of an upcoming eye surgery. Living under the same roof forces them to confront the distance between them and the grievances of their past.

results.title: The Night Everything Changed
results.overview: When Tina's teenage daughter doesn't return home from a sleepover with her closest friends, she goes on a frantic hunt to find her before it's too late. In the process, she unravels dark secrets of a forbidden romance and a tryst among BFFs.

results.title: Maple Leaf Pro Wrestling: Uprising 2026
results.overview: The Mega Event weekend continues with MLP: Uprising 2026, streaming live on TrillerTV as Maple Leaf Pro Wrestling delivers another night of high-impact international competition.  Uprising is headlined by the dominant powerhouse duo The Good Brothers — Karl Anderson & Doc Gallows, fresh off their shocking return to Japan via Pro Wrestling NOAH. The former multi-time tag team champions challenge all comers in a marquee main event that promises chaos and global intrigue.  Across the card, expect elite performers from AEW, NJPW, NOAH, DDT, CMLL, and international partners — creating a rare cross-promotional showcase rarely seen in modern wrestling.

results.title: Family Business
results.overview: A poor family struggles to survive through petty theft, but the father decides to abandon crime after an incident that nearly lands him in prison. He devises a different plan: each family member gets a job working for a wealthy family, concealing their familial ties. They constantly confront the stark contrast between their own world and that of their employers.
